description: card-review and card-walkthrough both document a monthly cadence ('1st of each month (scheduled)' and 'Monthly, triggered after the monthly benefits review') but neither exists in config/scheduled-tasks.json. Result: no reminder ever fired, neither workflow has ever produced an eval record, and the card data has aged 107 days (benefits-tracker) to 244 days (card-registry, optimization-guide) with nothing flagging it. The thing that was supposed to flag staleness was itself not running.
correction: A workflow that documents a cadence must have a matching entry in config/scheduled-tasks.json, or the cadence is fiction. Add card-review (monthly, 1st) and card-walkthrough (monthly, after review) as scheduled tasks.
root_cause: Cadence documented in the workflow file was never registered with the scheduler; no check verifies that documented cadences have live scheduled tasks.
